newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-ROMARIO GOAL GIVES BRAZIL WIN OVER ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMARIO GOAL GIVES BRAZIL WIN OVER ENGLAND.

text.p: Flamengo striker Romario skipped past the defence to score a brilliant 61st minute goal and give world champions Brazil a 1-0 win over England in the Tournoi de France on Tuesday.

Leonardo, playing on the Parc des Princes ground of his club Paris St Germain, cut through the middle to lay the ball off to the left where Romario stepped neatly over a tackle to steer the ball wide of goalkeeper David Seaman and in off the far post.
The win secured second place in France's four-nation World Cup warm-up tournament for the unbeaten Brazilians, one point behind winners England.
The competition ends on Wednesday when hosts France meet Italy in Paris. Both sides have one point from their first two matches.
